fallbackLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.preview: One click to confirm your Kitisel account.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up for Kitisel. Please confirm your email address so we can keep your account secure.
verifyEmail.expires: This link is valid for {{ttl}} hours.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn't create an Kitisel account, you can safely ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Kitisel password
resetPassword.preview: Use this link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Kitisel account.
resetPassword.expires: This link is valid for {{ttl}} minutes.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

articleReady.subject: An article is waiting for your approval
articleReady.heading: Your new article is ready
articleReady.body: We finished “{{title}}”. The facts are checked and the SEO score is ready. Please review it and approve it for publishing.
articleReady.expires: Nothing is published without your approval.
articleReady.ignore: You receive this email because your site publishes in approval mode. You can change this in Settings.

freeAnalysis.subject: Your free SEO analysis for {{domain}}
freeAnalysis.heading: Your site analysis is ready
freeAnalysis.body: Here is the report for {{domain}}. Site health score: {{score}} / 100. The report shows what to fix first and which topics your customers search for.
freeAnalysis.expires: The report link stays valid for 30 days.
freeAnalysis.ignore: You receive this email because you asked for it on Kitisel. We will not send marketing emails unless you agreed to them.

contactNotification.subject: New contact message: {{name}}
contactNotification.heading: New contact message
contactNotification.footer: You’re receiving this because a new message arrived through the Kitisel contact form. "Reply" goes straight to the sender.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received: Kitisel {{plan}}
paymentReceived.heading: Payment received
paymentReceived.body: We received your payment of {{amount}} (reference: {{reference}}). Your {{plan}} plan is active until {{until}}.
paymentReceived.expires: Your invoice will be emailed separately using the billing details you entered at checkout.
paymentReceived.ignore: You receive this email because a payment was made on your Kitisel account.

renewalReminder.subject: Your Kitisel {{plan}} plan ends on {{until}}
renewalReminder.preview: Renew your plan to continue without interruption.
renewalReminder.heading: Renew your plan
renewalReminder.body: The paid period of your {{plan}} plan ends on {{until}}. Renew before then to continue without interruption; the new period starts when the current one ends.
renewalReminder.expires: If you don’t renew, none of your data is deleted; your limits return to the trial level (3 articles a month, 1 site).
renewalReminder.ignore: You receive this email because your Kitisel plan is about to expire.

bankTransferOrder.subject: New bank transfer order: {{reference}}
bankTransferOrder.preview: {{org}} created a bank transfer order for {{amount}}.
bankTransferOrder.heading: Bank transfer awaiting approval
bankTransferOrder.body: {{org}} created a bank transfer order for the {{plan}} plan, amount {{amount}} (reference: {{reference}}).
bankTransferOrder.expires: Approve the order in the admin panel once the payment reaches your account; the plan opens immediately.
bankTransferOrder.ignore: You receive this email because a new bank transfer order was created on Kitisel.
